credits.title: Coward
credits.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

credits.title: The Distortion of a World
credits.overview: Oscar works at a company that designs mental simulations, technologies that expose the crumbling inner worlds of patients. What begins as observation soon draws him deeper into these fragile realities, until the line between watching and living dissolves.

credits.title: Interrail
credits.overview: Two best friends have their friendship tested on a trip to Venice.

credits.title: Weekend in Paris
credits.overview: A young couple of Flemish tourists take possession of a Parisian studio apartment, rented for the weekend on Airbnb. A strange noise comes from the kitchen...

credits.title: Les Gentils
credits.overview: With the relocation of their major customer, Michel and Blandine see their small business gradually go under, taking their staff with them. credits.title: Tibeau
credits.overview: Four months after his father's death, Tibeau tries to pick up where he left off. He mainly wants to move on. When he meets Ella, he realizes that with her, he can choose who he wants to be.
